name: Nibiischii National Park
policyReason: The Nibiischii corporation, which runs the park, says dogs are welcome on the territory on a leash.
summary: Dogs are welcome across the territory on a leash, but not in shared buildings.

excerpts.quote: Les chiens sont les bienvenus sur le territoire, dans le respect des visiteurs, de la faune et de l’environnement.

dogRules.text: Dogs leashed and under control at all times.
Dogs must not chase or disturb wildlife; pick up after them.
Aggressive dogs may be expelled without refund.
